headline: Cameroon: SVTs shun Treasury bond issues in September 2026
summary: The Treasury fully met its targeted amounts on its OTA bond issues in September 2026. Only 13.64% of primary dealers (SVT) took part, down 13.63 points from a year earlier.
why: Primary dealer participation in government bond auctions shows investor appetite for sovereign debt and affects how easily a government can finance itself.
original_headline: Cameroun : les SVT boudent les émissions obligataires du Trésor en septembre 2026
